text:
anna-support: FYI customer acct_9aBc reporting `403` on all API calls after a recent refund/chargeback. They say they had promo trial credits and then a refunded invoice. Can someone confirm if refunds are triggering credit clawbacks and disabling billing?

arjun-finance: Looking at ledger, there was a refund txn `txn_r98765` on 2026-02-28 that reversed a $120 charge and also reversed $25 promo grant. That left the account with negative usable credits.

eli-ops: When balance goes negative we currently flip BillingStatus -> `disabled` which makes auth calls return 403/billing_disabled. That's intentional for charge recovery but we shouldn't claw promo credits that were time-limited grants.

maya-eng: Can you paste the exact API error the customer sees? Also any request ids (x-request-id) would help.

anna-support: Customer sent this: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`
`{ "error": "billing_disabled", "message": "Account suspended for past due balance" }`
Request id: `req_5f3a9b`

samir-support: Quick repro on our staging: create acct, apply promo `PROMO-TRIAL-25`, then create charge $120, issue refund for $120. After refund, promo grant shows as reversed and usable_credits = -25. API returns 403.

billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice INV-20260228-334 was refunded; finance hold applied; customer SLA tier downgraded to trial-limited.

arjun-finance: The root cause looks like refund flow calls `reconcile_transaction` which deducts all credit adjustments tied to that payment. For promo grants we don't have separate flags to prevent clawback if grant was independent. Need finance + eng to decide policy.

maya-eng: Short-term fix: we can add an exception in billing-service: if credit_source = 'promo' AND promo_type = 'trial' AND grant_date < refund_date, do not reverse promo grants on refund reversal. Will open a PR, but need a decision on policy.

eli-ops: Prod mitigation steps we can run now: (1) create manual ledger credit +25 to bring usable_credits >=0, (2) flip BillingStatus back to `active` for acct_9aBc, (3) notify customer. Who can run ledger-put?

samir-support: I can run step (3) notify. Need finance signoff for (1) since it's money-moving.

arjun-finance: Approve manual credit for this customer as one-off while we patch. Create a finance reversal entry referencing `txn_r98765` and add memo "manual promo restore - customer impacted by promo clawback bug".

eli-ops: I'll run the ledger adjustment. Command I will run (for audit):
```
-- ledger tool (internal)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (account_id, amount_cents, kind, memo, ref_txn)
VALUES ('acct_9aBc', 2500, 'credit_adjustment', 'manual promo restore - INC-4321', 'txn_r98765');
```
After that I'll set BillingStatus -> active in the account table.

jess-cti: Creating internal incident INC-4321, tagging eng/billing/finance. Will also send a CS update to the customer with ETA ~2h.

maya-eng: I'll start a PR referencing INC-4321 and add unit tests for `reconcile_transaction` to ensure promo grants with `promo_protected = true` are not reversed. Link when ready.

anna-support: Thanks all — customer confirmed access restored after manual credit. They got ~3 failed calls before we unlocked. Please ensure we follow up with permanent fix.

arjun-finance: Follow-up action: finance will produce a short doc on refund semantics and which credit types are revocable vs protected. I'll own that.

eli-ops: Ops will add an alert for sudden negative usable_credits spikes per-account (threshold: <-1 USD) so we can detect similar regressions earlier.

samir-support: Note to self: include repro steps in INC-4321 and customer-facing blurb.

billing-bot: Automated: INC-4321 linked to INV-20260228-334 and txn_r98765. Audit log entry created.
